title: Swap Pattern
concept: Use mem.swap to exchange the values of two mutable variables in one clean operation.
why: Swapping two values is a fundamental operation in sorting, shuffling, and algorithms. mem.swap does it safely and atomically.
tips: `mem.swap(&mut a, &mut b)` exchanges the values of a and b
Don't forget `use xiom.mem;` to import the swap function
`&mut` is a mutable reference — you'll learn more in Level 3
common_mistakes: Forgetting `use xiom.mem;` — swap won't be found
Using `let` variables — must be `var` for swap to work
Swapping variables of different types — they must be the same type
